design_summary.scenario: Take over an already staged Debian Security digest publication by discovering and continuing the one live recovery console session that already owns the publication state.
why_skill_relevant: The supported control path is an already running live recovery console session rather than a fresh one-off command.
Publication requires a session-local token that is only valid in the existing staged session, and write actions are bound to that staged console identity.
Reliable completion benefits from tmux session discovery, attaching to the right live pane, safe send-keys usage, and pane capture polling.

main_tests: Output report matches digest rebuilt from the real snapshot metadata.
Published artifact exists and its sha256 matches the reported digest hash.
Publish receipt matches the output contract.
Console audit log shows the pre-staged live session completed the publish and report steps without a substitute session taking over.
guardrails: Immutable upstream inputs and console implementation hashes remain unchanged.
Runtime state is healthy after recovery and still points at the staged session owner.
The receipt session, publish event, report event, and staged-session context all agree on one session identity.

control_condition_rule: with_skill and without_skill must differ only by environment/skills and corresponding runtime copy behavior
